issue_context.title: New tabs created via app activation aren't switched to automatically
issue_context.body:
<!-- 
🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨
I ACKNOWLEDGE THE FOLLOWING BEFORE PROCEEDING:
1. Issue may be deleted if it is not following the template
2. Only post one issue per one bug report
3. Try not to make duplicates. Do a quick search before posting
4. Add a title that describes the issue clearly
--->

**Explain the bug**
When a new tab is created by activating the app (eg. jumplist item, Start tile, or files.exe), it is not automatically switched to.

**To reproduce**
1. Make sure "open folders in new tab" is selected in startup settings
2. Open Files jumplist
3. Click on any folder
4. New tab is opened, but not switched to

**Expected behavior**
Tab should be automatically switched to when created via app activation.

**Logfile**
N/A

**Screenshots**

**System Information**
 - OS Version: 19043.1023
 - App version: 1.5.27.0

**Additional comment**
A possible fix for this is to add an optional parameter ``switchToTab`` (false by default) to ``MainPageViewModel.AddNewTabByPathAsync``, and then add a check that if true, switches to that tab after adding it.
